    {"name": "wall_motion_idx", "event": "echocardiogram", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "wall_motion_pts", "event": "echocardiogram", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "weighting", "event": "baseline (study weighting)", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.85},

    {"name": "surviving_months", "event": "follow‑up outcome (death or censoring)", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},

    {"name": "cohort_id", "event": "cohort assignment (baseline)", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9},
    {"name": "alive_at_obs_end", "event": "follow‑up outcome (end of observation)", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
